accepted.quote: However, this sweeping proposal would, for the first time, direct Federal regulators to completely ignore any kind of risk a bank must manage, in this case reputational risk. This seems to be an overreaction that may have unintended consequences.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes eliminating reputational-risk supervision as an overreaction, indicating support for retaining bank safety-and-soundness regulation.
